The moment you've all been waiting for is finally here! Flame Keeper is blazing out of early access and into full release with version 1.0! notes.title: NEW MAJOR UPDATE - 2.00 Update is Here!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, guys![/h1]

This is an update dedicated to the Strategic Mind: Spirit of Liberty release later today. It includes all the fixes and improvements we did to the core mechanics while working on Strategic Mind. This is just one in a series of updates aimed at polish and post-launch support of the entire series.

Today, we addressed one of the series issues that was especially noticeable if you own all Strategic Mind titles - we reduced the disk space required for all games in the series. So, now it is easier to store them. 

[h2]Update 2.00[/h2]

[list]
[*] The game now requires less disk space (Before 41.1 GB | Now 38.2 GB)
[*] (For other SM titles we managed to reduce size by 20-35%, but here it worked the least. We will see if we could further improve in that direction, as it is right now the largest build among Strategic Mind titles.)
[*] Fixed various bugs while working on Strategic Mind: Spirit of Liberty
[*] Fixed some localization errors
[*] More fixes to come soon
[/list]

[h2]Non-exhaustive list of fixed issues:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Bug with “flying” Recon unit
[*] 3rd equipment slot abuse for some units. 
[*] The torpedo sound could still be heard when the volume is at 0.
[*] Units not getting extra EXP for capturing enemies that could not retreat due to various reasons. 
[*] Units keeping bonus from aura effects, even if the UNDO button returned the aura-giving unit away from them
[*] Abuse that allowed to return units to Reserve outside of the Deployment area.
[*] [Fight for Freedom only] Fixed the Sniper Squad (USA) equipment not providing +1 Spotting. 
[*] The crash caused by the illegitimate equipping of units outside the Service Zone (Which was possible due to a UI bug). 
[/list]

[h2]All other Strategic Mind titles are also receiving a similar update today. [/h2]

[b]You can expect more updates and quality-of-life improvements as we keep polishing the series and provide post-launch support for Strategic Mind: Spirit of Liberty and other titles.[/b] All relevant improvements will be delivered across all titles of the Strategic Mind series, as always. 

As today, with the beginning of the Steam Strategy Fest, we celebrate the release of [b]Strategic Mind: Spirit of Liberty[/b], you can take advantage of the special offer - all owners of the previous Strategic Mind series games can get the newest title with 15% extra discount on top of the existing launch discount. Act now, commander!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/34509/

With best regards
Starni Games team

notes.title: Headquarters: World War II, Dev Q&A, and Other News
notes.content:
General!

We have updated all the Strategic Mind series titles recently, with various minor issues being fixed, and with Strategic Mind: The Pacific getting a full Korean text localization. We plan to add more improvements and fixes closer to the Strategic Mind: Spirit of Liberty release next year.

[h1]Headquarters: World War II - our new project in partnership with Slitherine[/h1]

Headquarters: World War II is our first project with a publisher, and not just any publisher, but the number one publisher for niche strategy games - Slitherine. We are very happy with how the cooperation is going so far and we think that this project has everything it needs to become a very interesting and fun game for you guys to play.

Watch live announcement during the Home of Wargamers Live event:

[previewyoutube=WIaGkFdM6n0;full][/previewyoutube]
More information about Headquarters: World War II here:

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1381850/view/3141821682386771299
[h1]Watch the video Q&A with developers[/h1]

Our Lead game designer Oleksandr recorded a Q&A video and answered all of the questions we received. Here are some of them:
- Will you continue adding games to the SM franchise? Are you planning a SM2 with upgraded graphics and mechanics in the feature?
- Do you have a release date for spirit of liberty?
- When the Strategic Mind project ends with the last battlefield in Finland, what kind of project do you have in mind? Thinking of a new strategy game other than WWII?

[previewyoutube=5o6l50Cush0;full][/previewyoutube]
If you want your questions answered in the next Q&A session that will be held in February 2022 - feel free to follow the link below and ask us everything you want to know about our games and team:
https://forms.gle/sXq4vh1FNqkgyGFN6

notes.title: Update 1.05
notes.content:
Hello, guys!

Three weeks have passed since release and we have been hard at work fixing all sorts of issues reported by the players’ community. Now, we can say that we are 90% through, and we present most of the remaining fixes in today’s update. 

[h2][b]Update 1.05[/b][/h2]

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed serious issue with the secondary objective in Battle of the Bulge. The enemy airforce damage counter was working incorrectly leading to a likely failure. Now that is fixed. It will work correctly from the save file, but the already counted value will remain. So, you might want to go back a couple of turns. (Reported by: mmtt)
[*] Fixed the Poor morale effect on the German air force (after completing the objective during Battle of the Bulge) to carry over to the USSR air force. If you already have this effect you have to finish any of the operations 5, 6, 7, 8, or 9 to get rid of it. (Reported by: Foxador)
[*] Fixed Searchlight Control "Elsie" in multiple ways. (Reported by: VirgoCompany and others)
 1) Now it cannot be installed together with other Radar and/or searchlights. 
 2) Now it does not provide a +2 Air attack regardless of the day/night time. 
 3) Its cost was lowered from 110 to 80 Prestige.
 4) Now it combines Radar and Heavy searchlight effect, but takes only 1 equipment slot (as was originally designed). So, It both reduces the Night attack penalty by 50% and adds a +3 Air attack ONLY at Night. 
[*] Added missing Victory hexes counter in the primary objective of Battle for Moscow. 
[/list]

[b]Description updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] Corrected Battle of the Bulge operation briefing to inform about the Winter operation. (Reported by: Foxador)
[*] Corrected Sniper squad equipment description.
[*] Corrected Small searchlight description. (Reported by: VirgoCompany)
[*] Corrected Medium searchlight description. (Reported by: VirgoCompany)
[*] Corrected Heavy searchlight description. (Reported by: VirgoCompany)
[*] Corrected Searchlight Control "Elsie" description.
[*] Corrected Radio combat support skill (Hero Audie Murphy) description. (Reported by: Foxador)
[*] Added Last stand effect description. 
[/list]

[b]Visual improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Replaced V-1 models with V-2 models and correct launch pads in the secondary objectives hexes in operation Market Garden. 
[/list]

As you can see, most of the issues were reported by you guys, so your reports and feedback help us a lot. Right now, we have fixed most of the serious issues, but we will keep polishing and improving the game. Make sure you report any problems you face to our team on the community hub, or reach out to us by email: contact@starnigames.com

With best regards
Starni Games team

notes.title: Update 1.04
notes.content:
Hello, guys! It is still less than 2 weeks from release and here we are with the 4th update, fixing some issues with Korean language, as well as, bunch of other problems.

[h1]Update 1.04[/h1]

1. Fixed a technical issue with Korean language - in some places special symbols were displayed. Now that is corrected and all texts should look normal.

2. Changed V-1 flying bomb ability into V-2 rocket:[list]
[*] Changed V-1 3D model into V-2
[*] Added 2D art for V-2

notes.title: Weekly Intelligence Report #31
notes.content:
General! Our ever-vigilant intelligence service has prepared a news update, for your eyes only!
Here are all of our spy’s key findings.

[h2]SM: Fight for Freedom release. First results[/h2]

The Strategic Mind: Fight for Freedom was released 10 days ago. While it is too early to judge, we can already see the first sales results, and they are quite discouraging. We will give you a more detailed report in the next Dev Diaries issue, but so far the release was underwhelming despite our best efforts to promote the game. It seems that this time we got much less traffic from Steam, despite decent day 1 sales compared to previous titles. The game was not featured in the “New and trending” tab (unlike all the previous titles). Technically it was, but only very briefly. So, we will gather all the data and explain all of it in Dev Diaries.

At the same time, we are happy that despite the low number of players - those of you who did find the game, left mostly positive feedback. So, we are happy that most players enjoy the game and find it of good quality. It is very important for us to know your opinion. There are not many reviews for now, which makes sense looking at the sales numbers, but most of them are positive, and we hope to keep that trend, by addressing all existing issues in a timely manner.

[h2]Issues with cinematics (already fixed)[/h2]

Many of you could have noticed that during the first week there were some issues with cinematics video and sound. The truth is that we could not finish and polish them properly before the planned release date, and we did not want to reschedule it, so we were trying to finish them in time for the release. Unfortunately, some of them were added last minute and there was literally no time to correct the sound for them. By next Friday we sorted out all these shortcomings. 

We are sorry for these issues, and will make sure to have better planning next time and have everything ready well in advance. There were some force majeure factors at play this time, like one of our 3D artists breaking right hand and being out of commission for about 2 months and other problems. We will tell you about it in more detail in Dev Diaries, so stay tuned. Nonetheless, we totally understand that the players should always receive the final and polished product, and no force majeure factors should affect that. That is why we will take a more measured approach next time, which will probably delay the release, but ensure that everything is in order. 

[h2]New Strategic Mind: Fight for Freedom videos on YouTube[/h2]

We keep an eye on all new videos on YouTube that feature Strategic Mind: Fight for Freedom. We can recommend these two channels as they seem to have done quite a good overview of the game. We will keep you informed of the new high-quality YouTube coverage of the game.

notes.title: Units in Fight for Freedom #16: US strategic bombers
notes.content:
Carpet bombings make for some of the most striking images of the Second World War - there’s a reason why the sight of leveled cities was often described as “moonscape”. Not many planes were capable of bringing such destructive power across such great distances - and the United States Air Force had an entire series of them.

[h2]B-17[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38607672/e07bbbf2ab5ab73fe9a767f2f19d6a0f08a85535.jpg[/img]

The legendary B-17 “Flying Fortress” was a sturdy and reliable machine. Its payload was respectable, and its overall performance sufficed for hundreds of bombing raids across the entire Germany. The largest raid ever conducted by the Americans on Berlin consisted mostly of B-17s - and their combined might was horrifying.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38607672/f68c5d7f62b9d703b3ab379103b10fd2016c1279.jpg[/img]

[h2]B-29[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38607672/eecc48cf2cc636514d5777838424bcc18e23be23.jpg[/img]

Then, B-29 came around, dubbed “Superfortress” - its payload was 9000 kg. They wrought havoc across the Pacific, including the firebombing of Tokyo, and the nuclear detonations over Hiroshima and Nagasaki - the three most destructive air raids in the history of mankind.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38607672/8effe5dd14ab245fc9e96e07c494f66810243ec0.jpg[/img]

[h2]B-36[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38607672/d0c3f0f8493caaa53969fd65ab20a9845d3026e5.jpg[/img]

B-36 was slated to become their successor, improved in every regard, but by 1946, it was too little, too late. Although, it is not too late for them in Strategic Mind: Fight for Freedom, as we have an alternate history ending in 1946, allowing you to use B-36 in battle. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38607672/edcb91a118cc1f68cd4d7f6ca977ba74151f1400.jpg[/img]

[h2]Strategic bombers in Fight for Freedom[/h2]

In the US campaign, for the first time in the Strategic Mind series, the player would have the 
option to acquire Strategic bombers as core units. All three units: B-17, B-29, and B-36 will be available for upgrades as one series, which makes upgrades cheaper. They will have passive ability Overwatch breakthrough (similar to that of the fighters, but no need to activate it). Another unique skill is Strategic bomber, that allows the flying fortresses to deal extra damage to infrastructure and reduce the ammo and fuel of the enemy units by destroying their supplies. On top of that their combat parameters, especially defense, will be quite high. All this glory comes at a hefty cost though, both for the acquisition and repair.

notes.content:
Hello, guys! There are many opinions about the year 2020. Many think it was a bad and troublesome year. Some think 2021 will be even worse. We do not think, we make games. So, we will tell you about all the events happening with Starni Games in 2020, and let you make your own conclusions.

[h2]Strategic Mind: Blitzkrieg release[/h2]
We have started to work on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1200330/Strategic_Mind_Blitzkrieg/]Strategic Mind: Blitzkrieg[/url] back in 2019, right after [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/991810/Strategic_Mind_The_Pacific/]The Pacific[/url] release. Yet the majority of the work was done in 2020. It was tough to meet the deadliner, but we did it despite all the troubles. The release was a success, and the game is doing reasonably well. 

[h2]Big Battle: pandemic vs release [/h2]
We had to work remotely in April and May 2020, just before the Blitzkrieg release. Then we got back to the office, but in October went remote again for a month. Overall, working remotely and doing Mocap and VO mid-pandemic was quite challenging. If you want to know more about it [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1200330/announcements/detail/2933496588880999763]make sure to check out our Developer’s Diaries dedicated to these issues[/url].

[h2]Russian government stops the Blitzkrieg[/h2]
Soon after the Blitzkrieg release, the Russian government demanded that Steam remove it from the store in Russia. Moreover, the spokesman of the Russian president commented on it. They even claimed to file an official investigation request to the UN. If you want to find out more about the issue, [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1200330/announcements/detail/2247806424014858209]make sure to check our news about it[/url].

[h2]Free game Demo[/h2]
This year we started to create free Demo versions for our games, to make sure you can try them out before buying. We want to make sure that you know what you get.

👉[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1381850/Strategic_Mind_Fight_for_Freedom/]Check out our latest Demo here[/url].

However, at first, there were issues. When we submitted the Blitzkrieg Demo 3 months after we published the game, Steam blocked both the full game and the Demo. We had to start all the explanations anew. We managed to lift the limitation off of the full game, but only at the cost of creating a German-only version with Hitler’s face blurred. [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1200330/announcements/detail/2885076552142109470]You can learn more about it here[/url]. 

[h2]Strategic Mind: Spectre of Communism release[/h2]
All the while we kept working on the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1341170/Strategic_Mind_Spectre_of_Communism/]Strategic Mind: Spectre of Communism[/url]. The release date was planned for 13 November, and once again we had to work remotely for some time and faced some other problems. All in all, we managed to break through the enemy’s encirclement and released the game on time. It was our most polished and smooth release so far. 

[h2]Hitler is more popular than Stalin[/h2]
Strategic Mind: Spectre of Communism release was the least successful to date in financial terms, but the game got the highest review score so far. It sold 2 times fewer copies than Strategic Mind: Blitzkrieg. However, due to other projects still showing decent results we are able to continue with the Strategic Mind series. [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1200330/announcements/detail/2933497222873336045]We discuss it in more detail here[/url]. 

[h2]New Starni Games website and Starni Store[/h2]
Just on the last day of the year, we managed to release our new website - starnigames.com. The design was fully reworked. It will get further polish in January. You can also buy our games (Steam keys) there directly from the developer. Yet, if you prefer to do it on steam - we are more than happy with that. [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1200330/announcements/detail/2934623681424828503]You can learn more about the website and different stores here[/url]. 

[h2]Strategic Mind: Fight for Freedom - the work has begun[/h2]
In November and December, we were working really hard and made good progress, making a full release of our next title in Q2 2021 very realistic. So, far [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wWvKdLDLbh8]we have the first gameplay trailer[/url] and an early Free Demo with the first operation. We plan to update the Demo as our work progresses and release more trailers along the way. We will keep you updated on our progress through regular news and Developer’s Diaries. 

[h2]Developers Diaries[/h2]
This year we started to issue Developer’s Diaries regularly and plan to keep doing so in 2021, so stay tuned. In case you missed our story so far, you can check it out here:
1. [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1200330/announcements/detail/2746585154891303969]New VO and mocap setup[/url]
2. [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1200330/announcements/detail/5382318210069094881]Units’ speech review. Part 1[/url]
3. [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1200330/announcements/detail/2901962512557554806]Units’ speech review. Part 2[/url]
4. [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1200330/announcements/detail/2941374083279593000]Strategic Mind Franchise Soundtrack[/url]
5. [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1200330/announcements/detail/2943626518457443398]Undo feature, new music, and hilarious moments[/url]
6. [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1200330/announcements/detail/2926738653835865509]Designing winter operations[/url]
7. [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1200330/announcements/detail/2910976689287963848]5 days after the release, new ice visuals[/url]
8. [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1200330/announcements/detail/2933496588880999763]A windy road[/url]
9. [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1200330/announcements/detail/2933497222873336045]Communist Economy[/url]

[h2]Developer’s Gameplay[/h2]
We also started a series of Developer’s Gameplay, where our Lead Game Designer plays our games with commentary, telling you more about the game mechanics and the development process. 

[previewyoutube=out9Rh8xRvQ;full][/previewyoutube]
New episodes will be available in January 2021, so stay tuned. We want to be even more open and transparent about our production, so feel free to ask any questions you like and we will do our best to answer them in future episodes.

[h2]Wishlists matter[/h2]
You may not know, but the best indicator that the game will do well is to have a high wishlist count. That is why all game developers are really happy when they get more wishlists. So, if you want to make us happier and did not add Strategic Mind: Fight for Freedom to your wishlist yet, that would make a great New Year present for our whole team. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1381850/Strategic_Mind_Fight_for_Freedom/
[h2]Our power grows [/h2]
The power of Starni Games is in its team members, in their skills and expertise. When the Panzer Strategy was released there were only 3 people in the office, and a couple more remote or outsource. In 2019 the team grew from 3 to 10 people. After the Strategic Mind: Blitzkrieg release we hired 3 more people. A couple more guys will join our team in January making it 15 people in the office. We hope that[url=http://starnigames.com/about-us/] the team and the company[/url] overall will keep on growing in the next year and all of our plans will be carried out. 

[h2]The novelty in the Strategic Mind series and community feedback[/h2]
The changes to the series were gradual, but in retrospect, there were quite a lot of changes. A large portion of them suggested by you - the player’s community. Here are some of them:
- two new classes Armored train and Assault gun
- winter operations (visuals and mechanics)
- retreat operations (gameplay and mechanics)
- better Steam integration: localization, cloud saves etc.
- Steam Achievements and Leaderboards
- lots of new skills, HQ skills, and equipment
- lots of new units for various countries
- general performance optimization
- the Undo button
- additional game settings and hotkeys
- tons of bug fixed and improvements

[h2]Strategic Mind Franchise Soundtrack[/h2]
This year we started to produce our own exclusive soundtrack in cooperation with the Daraba studio. It is shared across the series. You can find it here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1358280/Strategic_Mind_Franchise_Soundtrack/
[h2]Strategic Mind Complete Collection bundle on Steam[/h2]
The Strategic Mind series is growing and we decided to provide an opportunity to save some money on getting additional titles, especially for our long-time community members. So, now you can get all the titles you do not have at a 20% discount any time, and on top of any other discounts, which is great. We will also add the next title to the pool, so if you already have all the Strategic Mind titles, you will be able to purchase the bundle and get a nice 20% discount at the release of Strategic MInd: Fight for Freedom. 

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/16499/Strategic_Mind_Complete_Collection/
[h2]Future plans[/h2]
[i]'If you want to make God laugh, tell him about your plans.'[/i]

This year was quite challenging and unpredictable, and we do not know what to expect from the coming year 2021. Yet, we will strive to keep creating the best games we can. We cannot disclose all of our plans right now, but you will be properly informed in due time. So far, we are concentrated on delivering [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1381850/Strategic_Mind_Fight_for_Freedom/]Strategic Mind: Fight for Freedom[/url] in Q2 2021, as promised.

We wish you all a great holiday and a happy New Year! 🎄

See you in 2021 🖤

Starni Games team
